title: feat(spec): an action param's helpText takes an inline locale map, so an inline action can write its hint per locale
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP?thread=cmsg_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP5HtnZiicdy84BcZoZeHwXZ)_
Fixes #28266

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md (its copy-holes line teaches a param's `helpText` as a sentence only; `skills/**` is a Tier H surface, so it is not edited here). This diff teaches the map in `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` (the `ActionParam` fields paragraph) and in the regenerated `content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：动作参数的 `helpText`（参数对话框里输入框下方的说明）现在可以写成按语言的内联映射 `{ en, "zh-CN", … }`，和它旁边的 `label`、`description`、`successMessage` 一样。校验门、控制台解析器和 AI 工具摘要都会按语言读取它。
- 为什么改：cloud 欢迎页的「邀请成员」是页面按钮上的内联动作，没有翻译包可走，标题、说明、选项和提示都写成了多语言映射，唯独角色说明只能是一个英文字符串，所以 cloud 只好把它省掉。注册在对象上的 `invite_user` 本来就经翻译包本地化（7 种语言都已翻好），不需要改。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽接受集，以前能解析的值解析结果不变；回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`（`actionParamHelpText` 加上 `localeMap`）、`ui/packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts`（`authoredHelpText`）、`packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.ts`（逐个语言判句）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/action-copy-template.test.ts`，预期全部通过，其中 helpText 一行是 “keeps inline locale map”。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec` — `ActionParamSchema.helpText` takes an inline locale map.** `actionParamHelpText` builds the copy family's slot with `{ localeMap: true }`, the option `description`, `confirmText`, `successMessage` and each `outcomeMessages` entry already pass. The slot now accepts a bare sentence, the `{ dialect: 'template', source }` envelope, a blank string (stored rows keep loading) or an `InlineLocaleMapSchema` map. It reaches both carriers of `params`: `ActionSchema` and `InlineActionSchema` (a page button's `properties.action`). Every value that parsed before parses to the same thing. A map whose key is not a language tag is refused with the slot's own sentence, which now also names the map form.
- **`@objectstack/lint` — the copy door judges each map entry.** `validate-action-copy-templates.ts` dropped the `key !== 'helpText'` exclusion, so a `helpText` map's entries are judged as sentences at `params[N].helpText.LOCALE`, exactly as a `description` map's are (blank, `${…}`, single-brace token, a hole over a root other than `record`, logic in a hole, unknown formatter: each an error). The i18n walk already files a map as authored text (`authoredEvidence`); only its doc comment changed.
- **`@objectstack/runtime` — the agent-facing tool schema reads a map.** `summarizeActionParams` reads `helpText` through a new `paramHelpText`: the string or envelope `source` first, else the map's source-language entry through `resolveI18nLabel` (`en`, then `default`, then any entry). An envelope with no `source` still gives nothing, so the bound field's description stays the fallback.
- **`@object-ui/fields` — the console resolves a map for the active language.** `resolveActionParam` narrows `helpText` like `label`: the envelope's `source`, else `resolveI18nLabel(helpText, ctx.locale)`. Before, `actionCopySource(map)` answered `undefined`, so a map fell through to the field's help line. The three branches (inline, unresolved field-backed, field-backed) read the one `authoredHelpText`.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` says a param's `helpText` is a sentence translated at `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION.params.PARAM.helpText` or an inline locale map, and that the map is how a page button's inline action translates it. `content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx` is regenerated (`gen:docs`).

### Premise reading (the card's facts, re-measured on `main` f67f3b35)

- The card says the spec "types action param `helpText` as `string`, so there is no i18n key or per-locale form". The **i18n key exists**: `TranslationItemSchema` declares `_actions.ACTION.params.PARAM.helpText` (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`), the walk emits it (`packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`, `pushActionParams`), `translateActionParams` overlays it server-side (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`), and the console overlays it through `actionParamText` (`useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.tsx`).
- The card's Work item 2 ("translate the `invite_user` role help in the locale packs") is **already done**: the role help (`MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_PARAM_HELP`) sits at 6 sites in `en.objects.generated.ts` (the four `invite_user` mirrors, `sys_member.add_member`, `sys_member.update_member_role`), and each of `ar`, `es-ES`, `fr`, `ja-JP`, `pt-BR`, `zh-CN`, `zh-Hant` carries a translated 5-line help at all 6, with 0 English left. So a zh session on the organization page's registered `invite_user` already reads the role help in Chinese.
- The **per-locale form was the real gap**: `helpText` was the one copy slot built without `localeMap` (pinned as "takes no inline locale map" in `action-copy-template.test.ts`). The card's consumer, cloud's welcome page, declares the invitation as an inline `element:button` action with no bundle, writes its label, description, option labels and toast as maps, and leaves `helpText` out on purpose (`packages/service-tenant/src/pages/welcome.page.test.ts`, the comment above `withoutOwner`). This PR closes that gap.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/ui/action-copy-template.test.ts`: the family table's `params[].helpText` row flips to "keeps inline locale map" (the map parses and is kept; the refusal sentence names the map form); a new describe pins `InlineActionSchema` keeping a field-backed role param's map and refusing a `{ key, defaultValue }` map with the slot's sentence.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.test.ts`: a map passes; a `${…}` entry and a blank entry are errors at `params[0].helpText.zh-CN` / `.ja-JP` on a registered action; a `result` hole in a page button's inline action map is an error at `· action params[0].helpText.zh-CN`.
- `packages/cli/test/i18n-inline-locale-map-coverage.test.ts`: the walk records a `helpText` map at its param key with `inlineLocales`, counts its locales as covered, reports the locale a partial map omits, and scaffolds no bundle row.
- `packages/runtime/src/action-param-help-envelope-27948.test.ts`: a map gives its `en` entry (same summary as the bare string), a map with no `en` gives `default`, an empty map falls back to the field description.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.fieldHelpLine-12213.test.tsx`: a zh-CN session draws the map's zh-CN entry under the control, over the field's help; an inline param in a locale the map omits reads `en`; an envelope with no `source` still lends the field's help.

<details><summary>Local runs (worktree off main f67f3b35, merged with main c6c24262; final head ea6ad0b1)</summary>

- Targeted, on the final head ea6ad0b1: spec `action-copy-template` + `action` + `i18n-resolver` 701/701; lint `validate-action-copy-templates` 26/26; runtime `action-param-help-envelope-27948` 4/4; cli `i18n-inline-locale-map-coverage` 20/20; ui `ActionParamDialog.fieldHelpLine-12213` + `ActionParamDialog.recordHoles-12967` 13/13.
- Earlier on 87e90400: lint `validate-action-copy-templates` + `validate-translation-references` 259/259; ui `packages/fields/` whole + six ActionParamDialog / useConsoleActionRuntime / RecordDetailView files → Test Files 306 passed, 1 skipped; Tests 4,640 passed, 7 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` → exit 0 (both include `check:test-typecheck`). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:test-typecheck` → OK (52 files / 240 errors / 131 pinned signatures held). `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` (both its programs) → exit 0 after building its dependency closure. `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check (the new dialog cases) is left to `Type Check UI`.

<details><summary>Ablations (each mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 → 0, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty; every subject resolves through source — a relative import or the ui vitest alias — so no dist leg)</summary>

- A1 spec, `actionParamHelpText` built without `localeMap` → `action-copy-template.test.ts` 2 failed / 32 passed: the family row "params[].helpText: keeps inline locale map" and "an inline action … keeping the map".
- A2 lint, `sentencesOf(value, localeMap && key !== 'helpText')` → `validate-action-copy-templates.test.ts` 1 failed / 25 passed: "passes a helpText locale map and judges each entry at `.LOCALE`".
- A3 runtime, `paramHelpText` map branch returns `undefined` → 2 failed / 2 passed: both #28266 cases; the two #27948 envelope cases stay green.
- A4 console, `authoredHelpText` read through `actionCopySource` again → `ActionParamDialog.fieldHelpLine-12213.test.tsx` 2 failed / 8 passed: the zh-CN and the inline-param map cases; the envelope-with-no-source control stays green.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **cloud follow-up (carrier: cloud).** The welcome page's `INVITE_ACTION` can carry the role help as a 4-locale map (`en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`, copied from the framework bundles like its other copy) once a cloud pin round carries this PR; `welcome.page.test.ts` then compares it to the bundles instead of leaving it out. That is the card's "a zh session sees the role help in Chinese" on the welcome page.
- **`summarizeActionParams` reads a param `label` map as absent (observation, not fixed here).** `typeof p.label === 'string' ? p.label : field?.label` gives an inline param with a map label no label in the agent-facing tool schema. Same call site, different key, pre-existing; left for its own card.
- **`ActionParamLike.helpText` (`i18n-resolver.ts`) stays typed `string | envelope`,** like its sibling `ActionLike.description`, which also takes a map and is typed the same way. `translateActionParams` passes an authored map through unchanged when no bundle sentence exists, as it does for `description`. Widening both interface types together is a separate, API-surface change.
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` cannot run on this shallow clone (its positive control is pinned to commit 621a4876); NOT MEASURED locally, CI runs it on a full clone.
